visible.rule: visible=false sets hidden and aria-hidden=true; visible=true removes aria-hidden and hidden.

enabled.rule: enabled=false disables native controls and exposes aria-disabled=true.

selected.rule: Selection state uses aria-selected and canonical selected class.

pressed.rule: Toggle-action state uses aria-pressed and the accepted active class.

checked.rule: Checkable controls synchronize native checked and aria-checked when role requires it.

busy.rule: Busy state uses aria-busy and data-busy; it does not invent paint.

readonly.rule: Readonly state synchronizes native property and aria-readonly.

required.rule: Required state synchronizes native property and aria-required.

current.rule: Current/focused navigation state uses aria-current; false removes it.

invalid.rule: Validation state uses aria-invalid; false removes it.

loading.rule: Loading is a semantic alias for busy plus data-loading.

requiredA11y: complete canonical group chrome when headed

requirements: Disabled uses native disabled and aria-disabled where needed.
Focus lifecycle and Escape dismissal are Core-owned.
Separator exposes orientation and remains the sole resize gesture owner.
Visual state has textual equivalent; no live-region role is implied unless the owning runtime already provides one.
Selected/current state is exposed with aria-selected/aria-current where applicable.

accessibilityAttributes.aria-label: Accessible name for icon-only or otherwise ambiguous interactive controls.
accessibilityAttributes.aria-modal: Modal dialog semantics owned by the Core dialog runtime.
